selected_meshes.filename: MM420_BP51969_FMA74912_Trunk of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.obj
selected_meshes.role: Arises at Left Main bifurcation (dist=0.018mm from MM557) and courses to proximal interventricular groove.

selected_meshes.filename: MM424_BP51969_FMA74912_Trunk of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.obj
selected_meshes.role: Contiguous with MM420 (dist=0.040mm), courses down the anterior interventricular groove.

selected_meshes.filename: MM425_BP51969_FMA74912_Trunk of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery.obj
selected_meshes.role: Contiguous with MM424 (dist=0.041mm), reaches the cardiac apex at Z=1186.97.

lad.continuity_evidence: MM420, MM424, and MM425 represent longitudinal segments (proximal, mid, distal) of the single LAD trunk (FMA74912). They do not duplicate geometry; their boundaries touch within 0.041 mm.

selected_meshes.filename: MM426_BP51973_FMA74923_Trunk of circumflex branch of left coronary artery.obj
selected_meshes.role: Originates at Left Main bifurcation (dist=0.190mm from MM557) and courses along the anterior-lateral AV groove.

selected_meshes.filename: MM635_BP51973_FMA74923_Trunk of circumflex branch of left coronary artery.obj
selected_meshes.role: Contiguous continuation of LCX trunk (dist=0.127mm from MM426), wrapping posteriorly around left AV groove towards cardiac crux.

lcx.continuity_evidence: MM426 and MM635 represent the proximal and distal segments of the circumflex trunk (FMA74923). MM635 is a high-resolution mesh running from Z=1235 down to Z=1189 where it abuts MM426 with 0.127 mm clearance.
side_branches: MM610 (Left marginal artery / Obtuse Marginal, branches from MM426 at dist=0.091mm)
MM428 (First posterior ventricular branch, branches from MM635 at dist=0.127mm)

selected_meshes.role: Arises from right aortic sinus of bulb (MM558, dist=0.142mm) and courses anteriorly into right AV groove.
Contiguous with MM556 (dist=0.102mm), descends vertically along the right anterior atrioventricular sulcus.
Contiguous with MM436 (dist=0.116mm), rounds the acute margin onto the posterior diaphragmatic surface.

rca.continuity_evidence: MM556, MM436, and MM439 represent longitudinal segments of the RCA trunk (FMA3802). Together they form the complete right coronary trunk from ostium to crux with boundary clearances < 0.12 mm.
side_branches: MM438 (Sinoatrial nodal branch, arises proximal RCA)

selected_meshes.role: Connects left aortic sinus (MM558, dist=0.251mm) to the bifurcation of LAD (MM420) and LCX (MM426).
Coronary ostial origin for both Left Main (MM557) and RCA (MM556).
Primary systemic arterial trunk providing anatomical orientation above the aortic root.
Anterior outflow tract crossing anterior to the aorta and left main stem.
Major ventricular myocardial mass providing anatomical bed for LAD, LCX, and diagonal/marginal branches.
Central muscular septum beneath the anterior interventricular sulcus (LAD pathway).
